updated_text:
# Existing .pert plans should normally be maintained through perttool commands; direct DSL editing bypasses goal/DAG owner-confirmation checks.
project KSHIAI_ALL_TEST_SEAL_DELIVERY:
  version 4
  title "全原試験の因果封印・正式合格・CI成功と配備"
  description "Canonical plan for the user goal: causally seal and formally pass all original tests, full CI success, then deployment. Preserve historic SealGraph/PERT scopes; no paid trial is included. 2026-10-09 estimate 8-14 internal hours low confidence; velocity not yet measured."
  duration_unit point
  finish DEPLOYED
  goal_owner user
  dag_owner agent

milestone OWNER_SCOPE:
  title "所有者の全原試験と配備範囲を確認"
  state reached

milestone SOURCE_COHORT:
  title "現在ソース・全原ケース・因果接続を固定"

milestone CAUSE_SEALED:
  title "現在ソースの因果閉包を封印"

milestone FORMAL_PASSED:
  title "全251原ファイルの正式試験合格"

milestone CI_PASSED:
  title "同一SHAのCI全体成功"

milestone DEPLOYED:
  title "公開環境の配備・同一SHAとhealthを照合"

task source-cohort OWNER_SCOPE -> SOURCE_COHORT:
  title "全原試験と現在因果接続の一括検証"
  description "User goal 2026-10-09. Original 251 files and cases retained. Diagnostic checks do not replace formal acceptance. Points are provisional difficulty, not observed hours."
  duration 2p
  status planned

task seal-closure SOURCE_COHORT -> CAUSE_SEALED:
  title "現在因果閉包の封印とreadback・fsck"
  description "User goal 2026-10-09. Original 251 files and cases retained. Diagnostic checks do not replace formal acceptance. Points are provisional difficulty, not observed hours."
  duration 3p
  status planned

task formal-tests CAUSE_SEALED -> FORMAL_PASSED:
  title "全原単体247とE2E4ファイルの正式合格"
  description "User goal 2026-10-09. Original 251 files and cases retained. Diagnostic checks do not replace formal acceptance. Points are provisional difficulty, not observed hours."
  duration 2p
  status planned

task ci FORMAL_PASSED -> CI_PASSED:
  title "承認済みbranch同期と同一SHAの全CI確認"
  description "User goal 2026-10-09. Original 251 files and cases retained. Diagnostic checks do not replace formal acceptance. Points are provisional difficulty, not observed hours."
  duration 1p
  status planned

task deploy CI_PASSED -> DEPLOYED:
  title "既存公開環境へ配備しrevisionとhealth照合"
  description "User goal 2026-10-09. Original 251 files and cases retained. Diagnostic checks do not replace formal acceptance. Points are provisional difficulty, not observed hours."
  duration 2p
  status planned
